current_vulnerability_analysis.scenario: User A from Business A logs into HBOS. Catalog and customers are cached to HBOS_Local_Store_DB. User A logs out. User B from Business B logs in on same device/browser profile.
current_vulnerability_analysis.result_today: User B has access to User A products, customers, and pending offline outbox records in IndexedDB because localDb.js uses a single static unnamespaced DB and clearAuthData() only deletes localStorage tokens.
leak_vectors: customers store (names, phone numbers, addresses, credit limits)

target_remediation_design.user_session_binding: Initialize DB connection dynamically upon authenticated business resolution
target_remediation_design.logout_eviction_lifecycle: Explicitly close and purge or isolate local store instance upon user logout / business switch
target_remediation_design.outbox_protection: Warn cashier if un-synced outbox transactions exist before switching active business
